methodology.workload: Cyclic mix of three evaluated RAG queries and one read-only deployment-status query. No writes or approvals.
methodology.setup: Startup/ingestion excluded; no warmup requests. Semaphore wait excluded from each submitted request latency but included in profile wall throughput.
methodology.ttft: Not measured: the adapter uses non-streaming completions. Unavailable TTFT is null, not zero.
methodology.tokens: Only provider-reported token usage is used; demo mode has no invented token counts or rates.
methodology.cost: Token prices must be explicitly configured and usage present. Resource/time metrics are reported without GPU cost estimates.
methodology.quality: Task checks require completed responses, no output errors and attributed non-abstaining answers for these known RAG questions. This load test is not a semantic answer-quality judge.

interactive.token_rate_definition: Completion tokens divided by model call duration, including RPC, retry and backoff time; not decoding-only throughput.

cost_estimate.basis: Provider token cost only; read-tool requests make no model call. CPU, GPU, storage and network resource costs are not estimated.
